stemMd: Which example best illustrates a public good under the simplified economic criteria of non-rivalry and non-excludability?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A freely visible flood-warning signal that alerts all nearby residents

options.label: B
options.textMd: One sandwich eaten by one person

explanationMd: A common warning can inform many residents without reducing the information available to others, and access in this example is not restricted. Those features match the stated criteria. They differ from scarce, individually consumed goods.

distractorRationale.b: Consumption prevents another person eating the same sandwich.
distractorRationale.d: Access can be excluded and the seat is rival.
distractorRationale.c: Its contents are depleted by consumption.
